Chart.js 4.5.1 (`chart.umd.js`) is vendored from the official npm `chart.js` package.
The package's SHA-512 integrity value was verified before copying the browser bundle.
License: MIT; see `chartjs-LICENSE.md`. No external CDN request is needed at runtime.
